tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (GNU gfortran 13.3 REAL*4 build, dt = 60 s, damp_opt = 2 dampcoef = 0.003 zdamp = 5000 m, pert_coriolis = .true., use_theta_m = 1, hybrid_opt = 0; data/eqwefic/scm_dyn, the scm_ref namelist re-run with the instrumented binary) dumped by the ctessum-claude/WRF fork, branch earthsciml-instrumented, commit 83347b2 (dyn_em/module_em.F rk_tendency, rk_step 1 of the step; module_esm_dump), merged with the same step's radiation subassembly dump and the wrfout eta grid by tools/merge_dumps.py into data/eqwefic/dumps/dyn_column/esm_dump_dyn_suite_<step>.json. The rebuilt binary reproduces the archived scm_ref radiation subassembly dumps bit for bit (all but the three B9 variables). The column is horizontally uniform (u, v identical in the two tile columns, ww = 0, all map factors 1, c1 = 1, c2 = 0). Expected tendencies are the dumped mass-coupled increments of the named routine divided by the coupling mass of their grid point (muu, muv, mut), i.e. the instantaneous decoupled rate at the time-level-n state; references are single precision, so tolerances follow the rel 1e-5 real32 convention, with absolute Linf bounds on whole profiles where values pass through zero. Routines: calc_p_rho_phi (alpha', p') and phy_prep (theta, Exner function, T, rho, heights, dz8w, p8w, t8w, p_hyd_w, p_hyd), dyn_em/module_big_step_utilities_em.F; the phy_prep outputs are the radiation subassembly dump's state after phy_prep in module_first_rk_step_part1.F (p_hyd and p_hyd_w added in fork commit 83347b2). Inputs: wrfout ZNW, the dumped ph/phb, t (+ t0), alb = alt - al, pb, mu, mub, p_top; total water = the six WSM6 species. Measured residual over the three regimes (zero tolerance): Linf <= 1.2e-9 m^3/kg in alpha' (values <= 1.0e-2); p' differs by <= 0.016 Pa (values <= 38 Pa) -- the single-precision evaluation of p0 temp^gamma - pb in the Fortran; relative <= 2.5e-7 in p, <= 1.5e-7 in theta/exner/T/rho/z, <= 2.6e-6 in dz8w (a difference of heights), <= 9.6e-7 in p8w, <= 3.4e-7 in t8w, <= 4.1e-7 in p_hyd_w and p_hyd. Regime: step 60 (t = 1 h, early afternoon, convective boundary layer).

input_q_t.expr: rad_qv + rad_qc + rad_qr + rad_qi + rad_qs + rad_qg
